title: Freeze ecosystem scope and install is not activation invariant
purpose: Freeze the aom ecosystem scope and make install/stage inert while activation is runtime-mediated.
scope: Freeze first artifact kinds as policy-pack, workflow-pack and test-replay-pack.
Declare deferred artifact kinds and activation requirements.
Document blocked shortcuts for direct host mutation and policy weakening.
acceptance_criteria: No public marketplace dependency is introduced.
verification: Check docs include policy-pack, workflow-pack and test-replay-pack.
failure_modes: Community artifacts become production-promotable by default.
